items.video_description:
This is the 1.8L with the 1ZZ type Engine i believe, Wife's friend borrowed it and then with out our knowing took it on a 700 mile round trip we believe, they brought it back knocking and two quarts low on oil. So what you all think time to replace or rebuild it? Maybe something else like valves?

Update: For those asking what I found out and what I did.

Pulled the oil pan and found the number 1 piston crank bearing had spun due to oil starvation, which was allowing the piston to slap the underside of the heads.

Pulled the heads and found they had been cracked above the piston from it hitting.

Rough estimate of parts needing to be replaced was, Heads, Crank and bearings, Piston and rod, oil pump, this is what I saw without totally tearing down the engine for a complete breakdown of parts.

The amount of repair and replacement parts, plus time versus a rebuilt crate engine was close to the same price but even that was not economical for this old of a car.

Scrapped out what I could on Ebay and dragged the husk down to the wrecker yard.
